items.title: 迪拜DEWA与Acwa签署17.6亿迪拉姆Hassyan海水淡化二期协议
items.title_en: Dubai DEWA and Acwa sign AED1.76 billion agreements for Hassyan desalination phase two
items.summary: 迪拜水电局DEWA与Acwa于11月6日签署总值17.6亿迪拉姆的Hassyan海水淡化二期购水及股东协议。项目采用海水反渗透技术，设计产能每天6000万英制加仑（约27.2万立方米），项目公司负责开发、融资、建设及运营，DEWA持股60%、Acwa持股40%。
items.summary_en: On 6 November, Dubai Electricity and Water Authority and Acwa signed water purchase and shareholder agreements valued at AED1.76 billion for phase two of the Hassyan seawater reverse osmosis desalination project. Designed capacity is 60 million imperial gallons per day, approximately 272,000 cubic metres. The project company will develop, finance, construct and operate the plant, with DEWA holding 60% and Acwa 40%.
items.why_it_matters: 二期有明确建设规模与开发协议，但并不意味着总承包招标仍然开放。
items.why_it_matters_en: The second phase has a defined construction scope and signed development agreements, but this does not establish that its main EPC tender is open.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注反渗透设备、水泵、阀门、管道、机电安装及分包机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor reverse-osmosis systems, pumps, valves, pipelines, electromechanical installation and subcontracting opportunities.

items.title: 阿布扎比工业天然气供应合作协议提出10亿迪拉姆目标投资
items.title_en: Abu Dhabi industrial gas supply partnership targets AED1 billion in investment
items.summary: 阿布扎比能源局于11月5日与H2G Green、GasHubUnited、MUZN Energy及CloudEnergi签署合作协议，评估液化天然气向工业及商业用户的本地生产、运输和分销方案。10亿迪拉姆是目标投资规模，而非已签署EPC合同或确定支出。
items.summary_en: On 5 November, Abu Dhabi Department of Energy signed a cooperation agreement with H2G Green, GasHubUnited, MUZN Energy and CloudEnergi to assess local LNG production, transportation and distribution solutions serving industrial and commercial users. AED1 billion is a targeted investment amount, not a signed EPC contract or committed expenditure.
items.why_it_matters: 项目面向工业供气基础设施，仍需商业可行性及选址评估。
items.why_it_matters_en: The initiative addresses industrial gas infrastructure but remains subject to commercial feasibility and site assessment.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注LNG储运设施、工业管线、能源设备及产业客户开发。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor LNG storage and transport facilities, industrial piping, energy equipment and industrial customer development.

items.title: ADNOC Gas与沙迦SNOC签署天然气网络协同协议
items.title_en: ADNOC Gas and Sharjah SNOC sign UAE gas network collaboration agreement
items.summary: ADNOC Gas与Sharjah National Oil Corporation于11月6日签署战略合作协议，研究天然气储存、处理、长期供应、基础设施及液化石油气下游贸易合作。未确认新管道工程金额、EPC合同或公开采购时间。
items.summary_en: On 6 November, ADNOC Gas and Sharjah National Oil Corporation signed a strategic collaboration agreement to explore gas storage, processing, long-term supply, infrastructure and LPG downstream trading. No new pipeline project amount, EPC award or open procurement timetable has been confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 该协议可形成未来跨酋长国能源输配合作，但现阶段不是授标公告。
items.why_it_matters_en: The agreement may support future cross-emirate energy networks, but is not a construction award announcement.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进工业天然气输配、储存、管道、检修及下游供应链。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track gas transmission and distribution, storage, pipelines, maintenance and downstream supply chains.

items.title: EtihadWE与Al Ghurair试点132/11kV变电站数字孪生技术
items.title_en: EtihadWE and Al Ghurair pilot digital twin technology at 132/11 kV substation
items.summary: Etihad Water and Electricity与Al Ghurair PCS于11月5日签署备忘录，在EtihadWE选定的132/11kV变电站试点ETAP数字孪生，部署数字模型、智能单线图模块及培训支持。项目不是新建变电站工程。
items.summary_en: On 5 November, Etihad Water and Electricity and Al Ghurair PCS signed an MoU to pilot ETAP digital twin technology at a selected 132/11 kV substation, including a digital model, intelligent single-line diagram module and technical training. The pilot does not involve constructing a new substation.
items.why_it_matters: 试点可带来电网软件和运营数字化机会，但没有披露新的建设合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The pilot may generate grid software and operational digitalisation opportunities, but no new construction contract was announced.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注电力软件、数字孪生、技术服务及后续电网数字化合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor grid software, digital twins, technical services and future utility digitalisation partnerships.

items.title: 阿曼杜库姆推动本地供应商参与工业项目采购链
items.title_en: Oman's Duqm strengthens local supplier participation in industrial procurement
items.sector: 工业供应链及商务开发
items.summary: 11月4日举办的Duqm Opens活动汇集OQ8、Invest Oman及OPAZ，讨论杜库姆经济特区工业企业的本地采购、维修服务、供应商资格和国际市场拓展。该活动于11月5日报道，并未宣布新增单项建设合同。
items.summary_en: A Duqm Opens event held on 4 November brought together OQ8, Invest Oman and OPAZ to discuss local procurement, maintenance services, supplier readiness and international market access for companies at the Duqm Special Economic Zone. Reported on 5 November, the event did not announce a new standalone construction award.
items.why_it_matters: 对产业供应商准入、长期维护及本地合作具有实际市场开发价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: The discussions signal tangible supplier onboarding, maintenance and local partnership opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 寻找杜库姆工业企业设备、物资、维修和合规供应商合作机会。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Identify industrial equipment, materials, maintenance and qualified supplier partnerships in Duqm.

items.title: 几内亚Coyah—Farmoréah道路项目发布三个设备采购标段
items.title_en: Guinea Coyah–Farmoréah road project tenders three equipment procurement lots
items.summary: 非洲开发银行于11月6日发布几内亚Coyah—Farmoréah通往塞拉利昂边境道路项目三项采购：第一标段为3辆旅行车；第二标段为6套移动轴重称重设备，含安装、调试及培训；第三标段为1辆医疗救护车。属于道路项目配套设备采购，而不是道路土建招标。
items.summary_en: On 6 November, the African Development Bank published three procurement lots under Guinea's Coyah–Farmoréah road reconstruction project near the Sierra Leone border: three station-wagon vehicles; six mobile axle-weighing units including installation, commissioning and training; and one medical ambulance. These are equipment supply lots, not road construction tenders.
items.why_it_matters: 采购范围和标段明确，投标资格、保证金及最终截止时间需查正式文件。
items.why_it_matters_en: The procurement lots have defined scopes; eligibility, bid security and exact submission deadlines must be checked against the tender documents.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注车辆供应、移动称重系统及当地供货服务合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor vehicle supply, mobile weighing systems and local delivery-service partnerships.

items.title: 拉斯海马投资与商业峰会定于11月11日至12日举行
items.title_en: Ras Al Khaimah Investment and Business Summit scheduled for 11–12 November
items.summary: 拉斯海马商工会定于11月11日至12日在Ras Al Khaimah Exhibition Centre举办投资与商业峰会，预计汇集政府、企业和投资方，讨论科技、人工智能、房地产及投资项目并提供商务会谈。活动不是工程招标或已签投资协议。
items.summary_en: Ras Al Khaimah Chamber of Commerce and Industry will host the Investment and Business Summit on 11–12 November at Ras Al Khaimah Exhibition Centre, convening government representatives, businesses and investors for discussions and meetings on technology, AI, real estate and investment. The event is neither a construction tender nor an executed investment agreement.
items.why_it_matters: 可以直接开发当地开发商、投资者和合作服务机构，对GCI客户拓展较实用。
items.why_it_matters_en: The event offers direct access to developers, investors and potential service partners relevant to GCI's business development.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注现场B2B会谈、投资项目对接和本地合作关系。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Focus on B2B meetings, investor introductions and local commercial partnerships.
